race.title: Boodles Florida Pearl Novice Chase (Grade 2)
race.verdict: KISS WILL remains a maiden over fences but sets the standard on the pick of last season's form and should prove hard to beat if returning near that level. Ballygunner Castle is feared most back in novice company after improving to land a notable handicap last time, while The Big Clubman is also respected stepped back up in trip. KISS WILL (FR) BALLYGUNNER CASTLE (IRE) THE BIG CLUBMAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Kiss Will (2/1), Ballygunner Castle (5/2), The Big Clubman (3/1), King's Bucks (7/1), Chanceawetmorning (8/1), Largy Star (16/1), Lady Bluebird (50/1)
